title: Follow user intent to design, verification, and code
statement: As a reviewer, I can follow user intent through design and verification to the exact implementation, so that I can see what supports a requirement and where evidence is missing.

acceptance_criteria.statement: A story shows the personas it serves.
A story or criterion shows the design that addresses it.
A design element shows the code it explains.
The traceability view derives end-to-end paths from the recorded links.
The traceability view labels each link as current, missing, or stale.
An active persona with no accepted story appears as a visible gap.
Stories served only by a retired persona are grouped into one reassignment decision.
